current_head.message: fix: p0 integration issues - verification_runner outputs and CLI test async patterns

review_findings.description: subprocess exec without explicit shell parameter — runner.py calls asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(*argv, ...) but does not explicitly pass shell=False. While create_subprocess_exec defaults to shell=False, explicit is better than implicit for security-critical code.

Evidence file memory consumption — final_gate_agent.py reads entire evidence files into memory when recomputing SHA-256 hashes. For very large evidence files (e.g., multi-MB test output logs), this could cause memory pressure.
review_findings.recommendation: The code already chunks file reads at 8192 bytes, so this is a minor efficiency note rather than a blocking defect.

review_findings.description: Hardcoded database allowlists — TRUSTED_TEST_HOSTS and TRUSTED_TEST_DATABASES are hardcoded frozensets in safety.py. There is no mechanism to override these via environment variables or configuration files.
review_findings.recommendation: Consider adding optional environment variable overrides (e.g., TRUSTED_TEST_HOSTS_OVERRIDE) that extend the base allowlist.
